caption:
Your missed-call text-back isn't finishing the job.

Most setups stop at the auto-reply. The caller gets a text, and nothing tracks what happens after.

Fix it in three steps:

1. Text fires within seconds. Name your business, give one clear next step.

2. Assign the reply to one named person with a callback deadline, not the shared team inbox.

3. Keep the text, the callback, and the booked job on one record.

A text with no owner is just a nicer voicemail.

See it running on your own pipeline.
